question: Who among the following is the first Indian pistol shooter to reach number one in world rankings by the International Shooting Sport Federation?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Heena Sidhu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **On 7 April 2014, Heena Sidhu became the first Indian pistol shooter to reach number one in world rankings by the International Shooting Sport Federation**__.

 __
 
• In 2013, she became the first Indian pistol shooter to win a gold medal in an ISSF World Cup finals when she won the 10-metre air pistol event.
 
• In 2009, Sidhu won a silver medal at the ISSF World Cup in Beijing.
 
• At the 2018 Commonwealth Games, she won a silver medal in the women's 10-metre air pistol event and a gold medal in the women's 25-metre air pistol event.
 
• She broke the Commonwealth Games record of 38 in winning the gold medal.
 
• **Sidhu was awarded the Arjuna Award on 28 August 2014**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kajal Saini **is an Indian sport shooter.
 
• **Suma Shirur **is a former Indian shooter who competed in the 10-metre air rifle event.
 
• **Tejaswini Sawant** is an Indian sport shooter.
